mobile_delivery.ux: Android 4 uses a mobile-first cockpit with market chart, portfolio KPIs, system pulse, five-destination bottom navigation and secondary tools behind More; it does not render the desktop information hierarchy as a long mobile page
mobile_delivery.canonical_product: when the configured HTTPS Secure Gateway exposes /api/product/*, Android reads and mutates bounded Paper/Research/Risk/Recovery through the Python backend
mobile_delivery.local_fallback: when canonical backend is unavailable, the existing local deterministic Paper/Risk mirror remains available and is visibly labelled LOCAL FALLBACK
mobile_delivery.public_market: Bybit closed candles through bounded read-only native bridge
mobile_delivery.mission_control: reads the real /api/product/mission/full contract through the approved HTTPS gateway and surfaces tasks, workers, resources, strategy evidence, CI exact-head evidence and true owner actions; if unavailable it shows MISSION UNSYNCED and does not fabricate state
mobile_delivery.audit_replay: canonical backend replay/recovery when connected; local SHA-256 event chain otherwise
mobile_delivery.live: visible but owner-controlled and locked; no exchange order, withdrawal, signing or private credential path
